title: Law to require standard designs for small city buildings
summary: This bill would require the Department of Design and Construction to create and maintain a catalog of pre-approved standard designs for small, recurring capital structures such as public restrooms, field houses and storage buildings. These structures must be no larger than 2,500 square feet and cost no more than $10 million. City agencies would have to use a catalog design for such projects unless the agency head finds no design can be adapted to the site, and the law would take effect one year after passage.
